products.title: Thunderbolt Dock 280W G4
products.description: This HP Thunderbolt 4 dock enhances your security, productivity, and connectivity. It offers robust protection for your network and devices from the moment you log in, supports multiple operating systems, and can drive up to four 4K displays. Designed for ITDMs and hybrid workers, it simplifies device management in both home and office environments. The dock features HP Sure Start for advanced security, double the Ethernet speed for faster downloads, and can deliver up to 100W of power to charge most notebooks. Its expanded compatibility ensures seamless connection with most notebooks and operating systems, including Windows, Mac, and Chrome OS, via a single USB-C cable. Wired Intel vPro support allows for remote management of vPro-enabled notebooks, and IT managers can schedule dock firmware updates with a one-click installer.
